title: A small world. A working system.
subtitle: Follow the signal. Watch the Reserve respond.
diagram: Interactive diagram of market, monetary engine, Charter and vault relationships
artAlt: Original miniature white limestone central bank towers with blue glass atrium
branches: Illustrative branches belonging to one Charter

expansion.title: Capital enters the market.
expansion.body: ETH in from buys exceeds ETH out from sells. The market sends a positive net-flow signal.

expansion.title: An epoch closes. Policy expands.
expansion.body: Positive net flow sets expansion policy. Sustained inflow can increase issuance accrued proportionally by branches.

expansion.title: A banker chooses to grow.
expansion.body: Buying an Expansion License burns STANDARD and opens a branch. This is a banker’s decision, not an automatic purchase.

expansion.title: Revenue builds the balance sheet.
expansion.body: The active expansion vault accumulates reserves from its revenue allocation. Market inflow itself is not a direct vault deposit.

contraction.title: Capital leaves the market.
contraction.body: ETH out from sells meets or exceeds ETH in from buys. Net flow is zero or negative.

contraction.title: An epoch closes. Policy tightens.
contraction.body: The engine enters contraction. Its policy response follows the epoch’s net-flow signal.

contraction.title: Branch issuance is cut.
contraction.body: The issuance rate tightens. Branches still represent proportional participation; contraction does not mean issuance must stop.

contraction.title: The contraction vault responds.
contraction.body: Its allocated revenue supports STANDARD buybacks and burns. This mechanism is not a guarantee of price or solvency.

market.title: One market. One signal.
market.body: Net ETH flow is ETH entering through buys minus ETH leaving through sells. Dashed blue lines show this signal, not a transfer of money.

bank.title: Policy at the epoch boundary
bank.body: The monetary engine reads net flow to set policy. This short animation compresses the timeline and illustrates relationships, not exact execution timing.

charter.title: A Charter holds branches
charter.body: A Banker holds a Charter. Branches accrue a proportional share of issuance. Accrual is not immediately minted into a wallet; withdrawal retires a branch and applies resolution rules.

vault.title: Two roles for revenue
vault.body: Expansion routes its active-vault allocation to reserve accumulation; contraction supports buybacks and burns. Liquidity and team allocations are outside this simplified diagram.
